File: /trunk/core/src/main/java/r/base/random/RNG.java (r317)
===============================================================================

Line 87: public static DoubleVector runif(int n, double a, double b) {
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The random generation functions allow recycling of the distribution
parameters :-(

So try :

mean(rnorm(10000, mean=c(0,50)))

Unfortunately this recycling doesn't work in the standard way because the
total number of cycles is dictated by the n argument rather than by simply
the lengths of the recycled vectors.

We could handle this at the code generation level (e.g. a @Cycles
annotation that you could annotate n with), but for some distributions
where initialization is expensive, it may make more sense to handle it
explicitly.
